7.     ORDINANCE —2” READING Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, land
                                        —

Dr. Rinne moved to approve on 2” reading, seconded by Mr. Segrave. Motion carried by
unanimous voice vote.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report.

Dr. Rinne moved to approve on 2” reading, seconded by Mr. Segrave. Motion carried by
unanimous voice vote.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report.
